THE SAMPLE LIST CLAUSE ACT, 2018

1. Short title, extent and commencement.— (1) This Act may be called the Sample List Clause Act, 2018.
(2) It extends to the Islamabad Capital Territory.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

4. Functions of the Authority.— The Authority shall—
(i) monitor healthcare services in the Islamabad Capital Territory;
0) provide guidelines to the Registration Board for grant, renewal, suspension or cancellation of registrations;
(k) advise the Government on the standards to be followed by healthcare establishments.

5. Meetings.— The Board shall meet at least once in every quarter.

6. Membership.— The Board shall consist of—
(l) the Director General of the Authority;
0) the Treasurer of the University;
(m) such other persons as may be prescribed by regulations.

10. Register.— The Authority shall keep a register of healthcare professionals.
20. Penalty.— A person who contravenes this Act shall be liable to a fine of one million rupees.
